description: This file is a JavaScript source code for Modernizr v2.8.3, a feature detection library that tests for support of CSS3 and HTML5 features in the browser. It defines a global Modernizr object with various feature detection methods and properties, and includes an HTML5 shiv for older IE support.
external_files: Yepnope.js (implied, as Modernizr.load() is based on it)

classes.name: html5
classes.description: An object for shiving HTML5 elements in older browsers.

methods.name: addTest
methods.description: Allows users to add custom feature tests to the Modernizr object.

methods.name: testProp
methods.description: Tests support for a given CSS property.

methods.name: testAllProps
methods.description: Tests support for a CSS property with vendor prefixes.

methods.name: testStyles
methods.description: Injects styles into the document and runs a test callback.

methods.name: prefixed
methods.description: Returns the vendor-prefixed or unprefixed version of a CSS property or DOM method.
